newsitem.title: UK: GKN, Brambles buy Mabeg GmbH.
newsitem.headline: GKN, Brambles buy Mabeg GmbH.

text.p: Diversified British engineering group GKN Plc said that it and Brambles Industries Limited of Australia had agreed to acquire Germany's Mabeg GmbH.
Mabeg will be acquired by a new German holding company owned equally by GKN and Brambles. The cash consideration is approximately DM 135 million (54.7 million stg).
GKN said it expected the transaction to be completed early in January, following receipt of EU clearance.
Mabeg, a German provider of environmental and waste management services, will be managed as part of the Cleanaway Group of companies, owned by GKN and Brambles.
Mabeg has a turnover of DM 150 million and employs around 600 people. It is currently owned by two major German construction companies Heitkamp GmbH and Strabag Bau-AG.
Mabeg has a strong presence in the north and west of Germany. Its waste collection and recycling services are similar to Cleanaway's UK and Dutch operations.

"For the Cleanaway Group this represents a key step in establishing a major position in Germany, one of the world's most environmentally advanced markets," said Cleanaway Chief Executive Gerben Westra.

"Cleanaway's core competences in industrial, commercial and municipal waste management represent an excellent fit with Mabeg. Mabeg's business and potential will provide an ideal platform for further expansion," he added.
